description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kirindiwela, Dompe D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511010
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations and determinations by the Commissioner of Land Title Settlement. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels, their owners, property details, and legal status under the Registration of Title Act. The content focuses entirely on land ownership matters, property boundaries, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
